parole.testo: From Danish krone (“crown”) and Norwegian krone. Doublet of corona, crown, korona, koruna, krona, and króna.

parole.significato: A small arctic and subarctic rodent of the tribes Lemmini, Dicrostonychini and Lagurini.
parole.testo: From Danish and Norwegian lemming, from Old Norse lómundr, læmingi, læmingr (“lemming”), perhaps from Sami luomek. Sense 2 derives from a longstanding myth that they exhibit so much herd mentality that populations jump off cliffs to their deaths together.

parole.significato: A long natural blowing horn without finger holes, played by embouchure.
parole.testo: From Danish lur, Norwegian lur, and Swedish lur, all from Old Norse lúðr (“trumpet”).

parole.significato: To drink the entire contents of a drinking vessel without pausing.
parole.testo: See skull. The verb sense may derive from Danish/Norwegian/Swedish skål.

parole.testo: From Danish/Norwegian/Swedish skål, which is used when making a toast and also means "bowl".
